query:
UPDATE builds SET iscurrent = 0 WHERE id IN (
              SELECT b.id FROM builds b
              WHERE b.jobset_id = $1 AND b.iscurrent = 1
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM jobsetevalmembers m
                  WHERE m.eval = $2 AND m.build = b.id)
              ORDER BY b.id LIMIT $3)
